d.ko: Brutal Orchestra is a Turn-Based Roguelike Strategy Game. You died, someone killed you. You are in Purgatory and you will never escape. Make a deal with the "demon" Bosch and set off into Purgatory finding ​all manner of demented friends and foes on your quest to get petty revenge.

d.zh: 《残烈管弦》是一款回合制类 Rogue 策略游戏。你死了，有人杀了你。如今你身处炼狱，永无脱身之日。与名为博斯的 "恶魔" 达成交易，踏入炼狱；在寻求一场无聊复仇的旅途中，结识形形色色的疯狂恶友，对抗堕落怪敌。
